components/widgets/EdgeChallengeFlow/con.name: Challenge replay settings
components/widgets/EdgeChallengeFlow/con.description: Holds the five flow-step labels, the playback speed options, the Sepolia Arbiscan base URL and the path of the decoded log JSON.

components/widgets/EdgeChallengeFlow/Con.name: Replay controls
components/widgets/EdgeChallengeFlow/Con.description: Renders the Play, Pause, Next, Show all and Reset buttons plus the speed picker that drive the challenge replay.

components/widgets/EdgeChallengeFlow/D3E.name: Edge tree diagram
components/widgets/EdgeChallengeFlow/D3E.description: Draws one challenge level as a zoomable d3 tree, importing only the d3 sub-packages it needs and keeping keyboard focus across redraws.

components/widgets/EdgeChallengeFlow/edg.name: Challenge replay styles
components/widgets/EdgeChallengeFlow/edg.description: Styles the replay with Fumadocs theme tokens and the four ecf status hues from global.css, so no hex colour lives here.

components/widgets/EdgeChallengeFlow/Edg.name: BoLD challenge replay
components/widgets/EdgeChallengeFlow/Edg.description: Client component that fetches the decoded Arbitrum Sepolia event log on mount and composes the controls, trees, timeline and details panel.

components/widgets/EdgeChallengeFlow/edg.name: Challenge event reducer
components/widgets/EdgeChallengeFlow/edg.description: Applies EdgeAdded, EdgeBisected and one-step-proof events into edge state, builds range and level indexes, and formats hex and ranges.

components/widgets/EdgeChallengeFlow/Eve.name: Event timeline
components/widgets/EdgeChallengeFlow/Eve.description: Lists the onchain events replayed so far and scrolls the current one to the middle of its log section.

components/widgets/EdgeChallengeFlow/Flo.name: Flow step strip
components/widgets/EdgeChallengeFlow/Flo.description: Shows the five challenge phases as a strip, marking the current step active and earlier steps done.

components/widgets/EdgeChallengeFlow/ind.name: Challenge replay lazy boundary
components/widgets/EdgeChallengeFlow/ind.description: Exposes the MDX tag as a next/dynamic chunk with SSR off, so d3 and the sub-components load only on the page that renders it.

components/widgets/EdgeChallengeFlow/Nod.name: Edge details panel
components/widgets/EdgeChallengeFlow/Nod.description: Shows the selected edge's ids, range and status with Arbiscan links and copy buttons that report a refused clipboard write.

components/widgets/EdgeChallengeFlow/typ.name: Challenge replay types
components/widgets/EdgeChallengeFlow/typ.description: Declares the decoded event union, the applied edge state, the range and level indexes, and the tree node shape the replay shares.

components/widgets/EdgeChallengeFlow/use.name: Challenge replay state hook
components/widgets/EdgeChallengeFlow/use.description: Owns playback position, timer, speed, collapsed nodes and selection, and memoises the derived state the panels read.

components/widgets/Troubleshooting/Check.name: Troubleshooting checklist
components/widgets/Troubleshooting/Check.description: Renders the Step 1 checklist; ticking an item highlights it and registers its label in the shared store for the report.

components/widgets/Troubleshooting/Confi.name: Config doc guidance
components/widgets/Troubleshooting/Confi.description: Links to the right run-a-node guide for the node type and network currently selected in the troubleshooting store.

components/widgets/Troubleshooting/index.name: Troubleshooting lazy boundaries
components/widgets/Troubleshooting/index.description: Wraps the five troubleshooting components in next/dynamic with SSR on, so the MDX registry does not pull them into every page.

components/widgets/Troubleshooting/store.name: Troubleshooting page store
components/widgets/Troubleshooting/store.description: Keeps the OS, network, node type and checklist selection in a module-level useSyncExternalStore store, persisted under a localStorage key.

components/widgets/Troubleshooting/Troub.name: Node config selector
components/widgets/Troubleshooting/Troub.description: Renders the OS, Network and Node type radio groups as native fieldsets and writes each choice into the shared store.

components/widgets/Troubleshooting/Troub.name: Troubleshooting report generator
components/widgets/Troubleshooting/Troub.description: Builds the plain-text report support channels expect from the selection, checklist, command and output, with a copy button.

components/widgets/VendingMachine/abi.ts.name: Vending machine ABI
components/widgets/VendingMachine/abi.ts.description: Holds the ABI of the quickstart's VendingMachine.sol that the cupcake demo passes to viem.

components/widgets/VendingMachine/index..name: Cupcake demo lazy boundary
components/widgets/VendingMachine/index..description: Exposes the MDX tag as a next/dynamic chunk with SSR on, so viem loads only on the quickstart page.

components/widgets/VendingMachine/Vendin.name: Cupcake vending machine demo
components/widgets/VendingMachine/Vendin.description: Runs the quickstart's free-cupcake demo in web2, local devnet or Arbitrum Sepolia mode, refusing other chains and timing out receipts.
